description: Kinetune generates lyric videos and Spotify Canvas loops from songs and cover art. It lets artists, labels, and automation workflows upload music, get exact credit quotes, create videos, and download finished outputs.
summary: kinetune.com exposes three developer integration surfaces: a REST API at `/api/v1`, an OAuth-protected Streamable HTTP MCP server at `/mcp`, and the `kinetune` CLI distributed on npm.
